overview: This House resolution assigns members of the House to standing committees, the permanent panels where bills are first reviewed. It places Representative Joyce of Ohio on the Committee on Homeland Security and Representative Shreve on the Committee on Appropriations, which writes the bills that fund the federal government. Resolutions like this are a routine way for each party to fill committee seats when members join or change assignments. The House agreed to it on April 21, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a routine step that fills committee seats so the House can carry out its work.
against: Critics say there is little to object to, since this is an internal housekeeping measure that doesn't change any law or spending.
